author: reek
body: A priority badge says one thing: how many bars out of four. BsPriorityBar has carried that count since it was written, and badge-widget bound it and then emitted a fixed 12 by 12 custom node, so Urgent and None rendered identically. Nothing in the tree matches the kind string "priority-bar" either, so no renderer could have recovered the count downstream.

author: reek
body: A gauge is the shape that already carries a quantity against a maximum, and every renderer in the tree draws one, so the count now reaches pixels instead of stopping at the widget.

author: reek
body: Read the count back out of the built widget rather than out of the style, because the style was never the thing that was broken.

author: reek
body: Count the distinct bar values across the five priorities. Before the fix every one of them was the same node and this read 1.
